cases.name: Carol Ann Farino
cases.about: She was a high school student and waitress at Milt's Cup & Saucer in Maplewood, NJ.
cases.narrative: On 11/3/1966, was found strangled to death with her own stocking in a driveway near her family's Essex County home in Maplewood.
